subject: Request: Evaluation window extension & supplemental credits for IntegrateX onboarding halt
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya@integratex.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir.shah@integratex.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: IntegrateX onboarding halted — ask for extension + temporary credits

Hi Tessa,

We hit an unexpected blocker during the connector handshake with our legacy SFTP gateway — the team reproduces a TLS downgrade on large files and it’s holding up the final ingestion tests. Samir and I have attached the logs that show the failure pattern; engineering is triaging but we don’t have an ETA yet.

Given this, we are asking two things:
- A short extension on our evaluation window (current sandbox expires Oct 1) — ideally 30 days to finish the adapter work and validate throughput.
- A small supplemental credit allocation to cover a burst of eval runs once the fix is in place (we estimate ~50k tokens while we finish validation).

We’re committed to moving forward — this is the last blocking item on our side — but need a little runway so the proof-of-concept doesn’t stall. Can Redwood approve the extension and the token credit, or point us to the right person to decide?

Attached: integration_logs.zip, onboarding-plan-v2.pdf

Thanks,
Priya Rao\Director of Integrations\IntegrateX
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: IntegrateX onboarding halted — ask for extension + temporary credits

Ben/Laura — forwarding IntegrateX’s note. They’ve hit a connector TLS issue that blocks final validation. Samir says this is on their side (legacy gateway) but will take a few engineering cycles.

Quick ask: can we offer a 30-day extension to the sandbox and a one-time 50k token supplemental credit as a goodwill gesture? They’re a mid-market target with clear expansion signals (DX-4291 in HubSpot). If we approve, I’ll confirm scope and provide the DocuSign link for the extension terms if needed.

Notes from their message (copied below) and attachments: integration_logs.zip, onboarding-plan-v2.pdf.

If you need more context I can pull in CS lead for technical hand-holding — Laura, can you confirm whether we should also open a concierge session for their SREs?

— Tessa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: IntegrateX onboarding halted — ask for extension + temporary credits

Thanks for the context, Tessa. I reviewed the hubspot notes (HS-347812) and the pipeline health — IntegrateX has a good chance to convert if we keep momentum. Approve the following:
- 30-day evaluation extension (new expiry Oct 31 2026)
- One-time 50,000 token credit to be consumed within the extension window

Please do the official confirmation to the customer and mark deal DX-4291 with the credit allocation. Laura, please schedule a 1-hour concierge troubleshooting call with Engineering to accelerate their fix; prioritize SFTP/TLS handshake diagnostics.

Ben Carter
Head of Mid-Market Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@integratex.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@integratex.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IntegrateX onboarding halted — evaluation extension & credits approved

Hi Priya / Samir,

Good news — Ben approved a 30-day extension and a one-time 50k token credit to help bridge your final validation runs.

What we’re doing next:
- Sandbox expiry extended to 2026-10-31 (we’ll update your account tonight).
- 50,000 token credit added to your account — usable during the extension window.
- Laura (cc’d) will schedule a 1-hour troubleshooting session with our SREs to work through the TLS handshake pattern. Please propose 2x 1-hour slots this week that work for your engineering team.

Action for you: reply with preferred times for the concierge call and confirm you received the updated onboarding plan (I attached the latest version we discussed). If you’d like, I can send an amendment/DocuSign for the extension terms — not required but available for audit or procurement teams.

Attachments referenced: onboarding-plan-v2.pdf (attached), integration_logs.zip (we have a copy on file).

Thanks for the quick update — we’ll keep this moving.

Best,
Tessa Morgan\Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0189
